title: Input head seek run
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of the one-work-tape machine `inputSeekStep` whose state is the active state. After any $r\in\mathbb{N}$ steps from $c$, the resulting configuration agrees with $c$ in every component except the input-head position, which is obtained by moving the head one position to the right, with boundary clamping, exactly $r$ times.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a finite list of Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration with one work tape, Boolean symbols, and unit state set
